title: Housing for Seniors (Follow-Up)
plain_title: Checkup on how senior housing units are awarded and overseen
agency: New York City Department of Housing Preservation and Development and New York City Housing Development Corporation
what_they_audited: How far the city has gone in carrying out the six recommendations from a 2023 state audit of senior housing programs, Housing for Seniors.
background: The Department of Housing Preservation and Development and the New York City Housing Development Corporation jointly run programs that develop and preserve housing for seniors. The initial audit found senior housing units left vacant for long periods, units not always awarded to the correct applicants and unmet requirements in a program assisting senior homeowners.

findings.plain: The agencies have made some progress but the Department of Housing Preservation and Development still has work to do. The Housing Development Corporation implemented its three recommendations while the department partially implemented two of its recommendations and did not implement one.
findings.quote: three (addressed to HDC) were implemented, two (addressed to HPD) were partially implemented, and one (also addressed to HPD) was not implemented

recommendations: Officials are asked, though not required, to report within 30 days on any actions planned to address the unresolved issues.
